## Protos (CR 25)

This figure, standing tall and imposing, has a humanoid form with two powerful arms, two sturdy legs, and a pair of intricately designed wings that seem to pulse with a radiant glow. His bright orange eyes, radiating an intense, almost divine intelligence, fixate upon you.  

**XP** 1,600,000  
Autrone tinkerer 20  
LN Large Construct (Outsider)  
**Init** +8; **Senses** Low-light vision, darkvision 120 ft., true seeing; Perception +35  


**Defense**


**AC** 40, touch 18, flat-footed 32 (+8 Dex, +12 natural, -1 size, +5 deflection, +6 shield)  
**hp** 400 (20d10+200)  
**Fort** +20, **Ref** +18, **Will** +20  
**Defensive Abilities** Aberrant Construction; Resist (cold, fire, electricity) 30, Immune disease, mind-affecting effects, paralysis, poison, sleep, precision-based damage, critical hits; DR 15/adamantine; SR 35  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft., fly 60 ft. (perfect)  
**Melee** 2 slams +30 (2d8+10)  
**Ranged** Arcane Blaster +28/+23/+18/+13 (2d8 force + 2d6 fire)  
**Special Attacks** Integrated Flamethrower (4d6 fire, 30-ft. cone, Reflex DC 28 half, 3 + Con modifier/day), Overload Burst (10d6 electricity, 30-ft. radius, Reflex DC 28 half, 1/day)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 30, **Dex** 26, **Con** 30, **Int** 28, **Wis** 20, **Cha** 18  
**Base Atk** +20; **CMB** +31, **CMD** 50  
**Feats** Armor Plating (x3), Enhanced Vision Lenses, Integrated Flamethrower, Rapid Reassembly, Tangible Innovation, Improved Initiative, Power Attack, Great Fortitude, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Combat Reflexes  
**Skills** Craft (Alchemy) +38, Craft (Engineering) +38, Disable Device +33, Knowledge (Arcana) +38, Knowledge (Engineering) +38, Perception +35, Spellcraft +38, Use Magic Device +32  
**Languages** All  
**SQ** Autrone Telepathy, Craft Invention, Expanded Innovation Capacity +5, Fix Anything, Jury Rigger, Quick Reconfiguration (3/day), Wondrous Inventions, Dweomer Reassembly, Arcane Overload, True Seeing, Teleportation (self only, 3/day)  


**Special Abilities**


**Craft Invention (Ex)** The autrone tinkerer can assemble a certain number of inventions per day, modified with Innovation Points.  

**Jury Rigger (Ex)** The autrone tinkerer  can craft items faster and without penalties for not having appropriate tools.  

**Expanded Innovation Capacity (Ex)** The autrone tinkerer can increase the IP limit of a single item by five points.  

**Quick Reconfiguration (Su)** The autrone tinkerer can disassemble and reassemble inventions 4/day.  

**Wondrous Inventions (Su)** The autrone tinkerer can cCraft magic items using class level as caster level, substituting Use Magic Device checks for required spells.  

**Fix Anything (Ex)** The autrone tinkerer can restore broken or sundered magical items.  

**Dweomer Reassembly (Su)** The autrone tinkerer can restore items with removed magical properties.  

**Arcane Overload (Su)** The autrone tinkerer can double the IP assigned to a single assembled item for a brief period.  

**True Seeing (Su)** The autrone tinkerer can see things as they actually are, as per the true seeing spell.  

**Teleportation (Su)** The autrone tinkerer can teleport himself up to 3 times per day, as per the teleport spell.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** Solitary or with other Autrones  
**Treasure** Triple standard  

**Inventions and Effects** **Arcane Blaster**: Ranged weapon that deals 2d8 force damage and 2d6 fire damage, with an increased range of 100 feet.  

**Flame Thrower**: Emits a cone of fire that deals 4d6 fire damage in a 30-foot cone.  

**Force Field Emitter**: Grants 2d10 + Int modifier temporary hit points, adds DR 10/magic.  

**Healing Injector**: Heals 2d8 hit points, adds 2d4 temporary hit points, and removes one condition (dazed, fatigued, or sickened)
